channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Xavier Tillman | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Xavier Tillman from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Taylor Jenkins on Xavier Tillman
item.description:
Justin Turpin:Taylor Jenkins on Xavier Tillman:

“Getting to know him off the court, too, as a husband and a father, he’s one of the most unbelievable players I've ever been around– a guy that's ultimate team oriented, all about winning and all about sacrifice.”

Taylor Jenkins on Xavier Tillman, Dec 7, 2024. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Jayson Tatum on Xavier Tillman, Lamar Stevens
item.description:
Jayson Tatum on Lamar Stevens being traded to Memphis in the deal for Xavier Tillman:

“Losing a key guy to our team. Maybe he didn't play as much, but his personality and how hard he worked, he was a great teammate and everybody loved Lamar. To wake up from my nap today and see he was traded was tough. The locker room did feel a little empty today seeing he's not here.”

Jayson Tatum on Xavier Tillman, Lamar Stevens, Feb 8, 2024. Source: The Athletic.

item.title: Joe Mazzulla on Xavier Tillman
item.description:
Joe Mazzulla on Xavier Tillman:

“Skilled. Toughness. Well-coached. Obviously we paid a lot of attention to him ... I think his extra defensive versatility.”

Joe Mazzulla on Xavier Tillman, Feb 7, 2024. Source: Twitter @SouichiTerada.
